definitions.explanation: Low in price. A formal or written-style word that can be neutral or slightly negative depending on context. When describing price alone, it is neutral; when implying low quality, it carries a negative nuance.

examples.japanese: {安価|あんか}な⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}す→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
{安価|あんか}で⟦{品質|ひんしつ}→品質：09507_hinshitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦{素材|そざい}→素材：09492_sozai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: I got my hands on an inexpensive yet high-quality material.

examples.japanese: ⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{安価|あんか}な⟦{労働力|ろうどうりょく}→労働力：16276_roudouryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{輸入|ゆにゅう}→輸入：01742_yunyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧こと⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{問題点|もんだいてん}→問題点：20619_mondaiten⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The problems of importing cheap labor from overseas are being debated.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal alternative to ⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧. Commonly used in writing, business contexts, and news reports. Unlike ⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧, which is purely conversational and neutral, {安価|あんか} can carry a slight implication of low quality when used to describe goods, though this depends on context.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {安価|あんか}な⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧: inexpensive goods
- {安価|あんか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{提供|ていきょう}する→提供する：21736_teikyousuru⟧: to offer at a low price
- {安価|あんか}な⟦{労働力|ろうどうりょく}→労働力：16276_roudouryoku⟧: cheap labor
- {安価|あんか}で⟦{高品質|こうひんしつ}→高品質：18051_kouhinshitsu⟧: cheap and high quality

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{安|やす}い→安い：00464_yasui⟧ is the everyday word for "cheap/inexpensive." {安価|あんか} is more formal and often used in written or business contexts. ⟦{廉価|れんか}→廉価：12489_renka⟧ is even more formal and literary.
